O1.invariant: The input/result is bound to a reconstructible source, snapshot, parent, receipt, or frozen reference before interpretation.

O2.invariant: A typed operation or observed process moves the system from an explicitly characterized state to another state without collapsing OPEN/FAIL/PASS/change classes.

O3.invariant: The output is assigned the strongest identity/claim class actually supported and is forbidden from silently upgrading into a broader semantic, causal, source, or capability claim.

GENESIS.source_bind: Parents, exact tested PR/head/merge commits, frozen public source refs, frozen sample hashes, provider/environment configuration.
GENESIS.controlled_transition: RAW_PROVIDER and GENESIS_BOUNDARY_OVERLAY are executed on the same frozen smoke pack; paired PASS/FAIL transitions and overlay delta are preserved.
GENESIS.output_identity_ceiling: The negative overlay delta is explicitly limited to this frozen pack/provider/configuration and is not promoted to an official benchmark-family score, Genesis-core score, AGI claim, or consciousness claim.

GENESIS.source_bind: Runtime version, player identity, branch id, Chronicle verification and preserved save/review/integrity artifacts are named and hash-bound.
GENESIS.controlled_transition: The witnessed path contains explicit state changes: awakening, exit interruption, destructive Severance, restoration, confirmed exit, restart and return into the preserved branch.
GENESIS.output_identity_ceiling: Persistence of the witnessed life/branch is preserved while the testimony explicitly refuses to claim that a complete life-cycle implementation already exists.

MUSIC.source_bind: Parent artifacts and the already-frozen prospective protocol bind what pattern and causal question are actually being tested.
MUSIC.controlled_transition: Evidence is routed through G0-G5 typed causal gates with explicit OPEN/NOT_PASSED/formal-model states and promotion rules.
MUSIC.output_identity_ceiling: PATTERN != CAUSAL_ANOMALY and A1 != A2 != A3 != A4 != A5 prevent a descriptive recurrence from being silently upgraded into retrocausality, CTC, indefinite order, microcausality violation, or superdeterminism.

MUSIC.source_bind: Official APP album/track sources, generator, workflow run, generated corpus commit and failed-attempt provenance are preserved.
MUSIC.controlled_transition: A failed concurrent push is preserved, the workflow is made retry-safe, and a successful 92-track corpus state is subsequently recorded.
MUSIC.output_identity_ceiling: Official track/album identity is kept distinct from JANUS interpretive reading; semantic recurrence is explicitly not promoted to artist intent, encoded JANUS, retrocausality, or an external sender.

PALOMAR.source_bind: The replay checks out an exact upstream commit, uses the preregistered same-64 sample lineage, freezes environment versions and keeps external-label sources firewalled.
PALOMAR.controlled_transition: The same-64 B3 replay moves from preregistered admission through execution to an explicitly typed PASS or fail-closed outcome; validation is deliberately written not to force PASS.
PALOMAR.output_identity_ceiling: Artifact hashes and shape-compatibility status certify only the replay artifact; the external-label firewall prevents morphology/compatibility from becoming an external-source identity claim.

PALOMAR.source_bind: Admission canonical hash plus frozen C0M/C2A gzip and CSV hashes are verified before sample construction.
PALOMAR.controlled_transition: The tool deterministically selects a source/tile-disjoint balanced 128-object holdout, enforces independence, then transitions it into FROZEN_BEFORE_C2B1_PIXEL_REPLAY.
PALOMAR.output_identity_ceiling: The resulting claim ceiling is ENGINEERING_HOLDOUT_FREEZE_ONLY: no new pixel measurement, no morphology inference and no external-label reveal; hashes establish manifest identity, not scientific source identity.

r3_1_vs_stricter_signal_decontamination.r3_1: One candidate survived distinct-source-anchor and permutation controls.
r3_1_vs_stricter_signal_decontamination.r3_1b_exclusive_signal_verifier: A later deliberately harsher verifier requiring at least two operator-exclusive signals per operator/document rejected all four target candidates.
r3_1_vs_stricter_signal_decontamination.interpretation: Textual survival is threshold-sensitive. R3.2 therefore does not use keyword survival as authority; it uses explicit source-grounded functional mappings and preserves both verifier outcomes.

critical_new_risk.name: META_LINEAGE_OR_GOVERNANCE_KERNEL_CONFOUND
critical_new_risk.description: Artifact-lineage independence is not the same as independent conceptual invention. All three domains live inside JANUS and may inherit a common proof-carrying/governance style even when file lineages and vocabulary differ.
critical_new_risk.evidence: The R3 machine catalog shows the same three-operator sequence in seven recognized domains, so the sequence is not unique to Palomar/Music/Genesis.
critical_new_risk.consequence: The surviving machine may be a reusable JANUS governance kernel rather than a special three-domain constellation.

next_gate.name: EYE R3.3 — INDEPENDENT ORIGIN / GOVERNANCE KERNEL AUDIT
requirements: Enumerate all seven domains containing the three-operator sequence.
Select matched non-target controls and map the same functional roles without using operator keywords.
Trace dates, parents, explicit cross-links, shared templates and authoring lineage to distinguish independent reinvention from inherited governance.
Penalize meta-lineage overlap even when artifact lineage overlap is zero.
Only call a cross-domain constellation novel if its functional machine survives controls and predates or lacks plausible transfer paths.
